## Caps interface

Bounds on what a run follows, each a whole number from 1 (README, "Caps"). A ref past one is cut (`{ kind: "capped" }`<!-- -->), never absent. Each counts per step, so the steps of separate branches do not race for one count.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Caps 
```
